Low-volatility pullback is triggering now; on APL's own history it won 71% over 17 trades (+1.2% net/trade), still profitable out-of-sample.

news.headline: Thatta Cement moves towards restructuring of Pakistan Services Limited
news.summary: Thatta Cement disclosed via PSX notice that it reached an in-principle understanding regarding the proposed restructuring of Pakistan Services Limited, subject to final definitive agreements. No transaction value, final terms or completion timetable disclosed. Logged as impact 3 (notable corporate restructuring development, still conditional).

news.headline: Cherat Cement announces intention to acquire at least 30% of Nimir Industrial Chemicals
news.summary: Cherat Cement announced an intention to acquire at least 30% of Nimir Industrial Chemicals, covering at least 33.177mn NICL shares under a share purchase agreement, subject to regulatory approvals, commercial terms, due diligence and execution of required agreements. Logged as impact 3 (notable proposed acquisition; not yet definitive/closed).

news.headline: PSX: Buying returns, KSE-100 gains 1% on hopes of easing Middle East tensions
news.summary: KSE-100 recovered on Friday September 11, 2026 to close at 170,511.85, up 1,646.81 points (+0.98%), after an early low of 166,141.17 and a high of 170,764.79. Business Recorder attributed the rebound to reports of Gulf-Iran talks aimed at managing Strait of Hormuz shipping, while noting Brent touched $109.97 and the prior day had dropped 3,078.56 points. Logged as impact 3 (notable rebound below 1%, not a fresh impact-4 shock).

news.headline: Oil jumps 6pc to USD107 on supply concerns
news.summary: Business Recorder reported Brent at USD 107.08 and WTI above USD 100 for the first time since May after a 6% overnight oil jump on supply concerns tied to the Middle East conflict. Logged as impact 4 (sharp commodity move directly relevant to Pakistan external account, inflation and E&P/refinery/OMC sectors, per Rule 10).

news.headline: IMF mission to visit Pakistan in coming weeks for next review
news.summary: Business Recorder reported the IMF mission will visit Pakistan in the coming weeks for the next review of ongoing programs including the Extended Arrangement under the EFF and RSF. Logged as impact 3 (notable macro calendar/review item; no disbursement or programme change yet).

news.headline: Official PSX market summary confirms September 10 KSE-100 close
news.summary: Official PSX market data confirms KSE-100 closed at 168,865.04 on September 10, 2026, down 3,078.55 points (-1.79%). The desk therefore discards the earlier alternate close level from secondary reporting and keeps the September 10 move logged as impact 4 because it was a material market-wide selloff during the oil/geopolitical shock.

news.headline: Oil surges 6%; Brent and US crude both surpass $100 on more tanker attacks
news.summary: Business Recorder reported on September 10, 2026 that oil settled about 6% higher after additional tanker attacks, with both Brent and WTI moving above $100 for the first time in seven weeks. The item reinforces the desk's import-bill, inflation and energy-sector timing risk channel. Logged as impact 4 because it materially affects the macro tape and the large E&P/energy-linked PSX names.

news.headline: Stocks stage mild recovery on value-hunting
news.summary: Dawn reported KAPCO's 4QFY26 EPS rose 7.7 times year-on-year to Rs1.14, with gross profit reaching Rs507m versus Rs11m, partly reflecting initial contribution from Attock Cement Pakistan.

news.headline: Nepra okays $58bn 11-year power plan amid reservations
news.summary: Nepra conditionally approved an approximately $58bn 2025-35 power generation and transmission plan, while excluding K-Electric's transmission line from the current plan and requiring further tariff and technical assessment.

news.headline: Govt raises petrol price by Rs5.02 per litre, HSD by Rs5.28 amid rising global oil prices
news.summary: The government raised petrol by Rs5.02 per litre to Rs375.82 and HSD by Rs5.28 to Rs403.32 for September 12-14.

news.headline: Weekly inflation continues upward spiral
news.summary: Pakistan's Sensitive Price Index rose 8.62% year-on-year for the week ended September 10, with weekly petrol and diesel increases of 6.18% and 5.49%, respectively.

news.headline: Futures spread narrows 7.02pc
news.summary: Weekly PSX futures spread narrowed to 7.02% from 8.69%, while average daily futures volume and value turnover declined 20.7% and 26.4%, respectively.

news.headline: PSL restructuring being negotiated to settle court case, says Thatta Cement
news.summary: Thatta Cement said a proposed Pakistan Services restructuring is being negotiated to resolve the matter pending before the Islamabad High Court; definitive agreements remain pending.

news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 sheds over 2,500 points as situation remains tense in ME
news.summary: The KSE-100 closed at 167,970.65, down 2,541.20 points or 1.49%, as postponed Strait of Hormuz talks and renewed Middle East tensions raised oil, import-bill and inflation concerns.

news.headline: SBP keeps policy rate unchanged at 11.5%
news.summary: The SBP Monetary Policy Committee kept the policy rate at 11.5% by a seven-of-ten majority, citing contained external-account pressures alongside increased geopolitical and commodity risks.
